Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
moe/moe_token_permute_with_routing_map/examples/test_aclnn_moe_token_permute_with_routing_map.cpp 中执行结果与预期不符

### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
Ascend910B3


### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
在 ops-transformer 目录下运行
bash build.sh --run_example moe_token_permute_with_routing_map eager cust
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
正确结果应该如下图所示：
![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/9808e969-1670-4c73-a25b-1278731ec48a/image.png 'image.png')
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
实际结果为![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/1464ad17-8bfe-4a35-912e-2863f2863ca4/image.png 'image.png')
